evidence.title: JustPaste.it - paste text and share with your friends

name: JustPaste.it
summary: Paste text or images and share them as a link, anonymously and without an account.
description: Simple publishing tool: paste text from any web page or word processor with formatting and images preserved, add pictures and movies, and share the result as a link. Anonymous by default, ad-free, and used by 10 million people.
contains: paste text with formatting and images preserved
anonymous by default, no account needed
no ads and no social media scripts
